claims.value: Fara1.5-27B is a multimodal computer use agent (CUA) for web browsers, developed by Microsoft Research AI Frontiers. It uses vision-only perception via screenshots to perform end-to-end web tasks, such as filling forms and booking reservations, by emitting structured tool calls.
claims.evidence: Fara1.5-27B is a multimodal computer use agent (CUA) for web browsers... It observes the browser through screenshots and acts on the user's behalf by emitting structured tool calls
262K context. Long enough for multi-screenshot trajectories with full action history.
Fara1.5-27B emits actions as <tool_call>...</tool_call> XML blocks containing a JSON object that calls the computer_use function.
